units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a minor country in East Africa with a population of ⟦1⟧. It is bordered by colonies of the ⟦2⟧ to the west and ⟦3⟧ Somaliland to the northeast, ⟦4⟧ Somaliland to the north, the ⟦5⟧ to the northeast, and ⟦6⟧ on the frontier with Eritrea in the north and Somalia to the south. It starts at war with ⟦7⟧, which seeks to annex the region into its other East African colonial holdings.

Ethiopia was attacked by ⟦0⟧ in 1935, leading to the Second Italo-Abyssinian War (Ethiopia had previously repelled an Italian attack in 1895-1896 during the First Italo-Abyssinian War) which ended with an Italian victory and the annexation of Ethiopia into Italian East Africa. Ethiopia remained under Italian control until 1940 when the Allies launched the East African campaign resulting in an Allied victory and the Allied capture of Italian East Africa in 1941, allowing Ethiopia to effectively restore its sovereignty. Mussolini's government collapsed and Italy capitulated officially in 1943, with Ethiopia's independence being formally restored in the Paris Peace Treaty in 1947.
Main article: Ethiopian national focus tree
⟦0⟧ gets a unique national focus tree as part of the ⟦1⟧ expansion. Without the expansion, Ethiopia utilizes the ⟦2⟧.
The Ethiopian national focus tree can be divided into 6 branches and 15 sub-branches, 4 of which are hidden until certain actions are taken in game:
This branch gives buffs to Ethiopia’s army, navy, and air force. It allows the upgrading of the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧. It also allows the removal of ⟦4⟧ conscription law

This branch gives Ethiopia factories, railroads, dockyards, and research slots. The leftmost section modifies and removes the ⟦0⟧ national spirit. The middle section builds infrastructure and allows Ethiopia to form the ⟦1⟧. The rightmost section gives construction bonuses as well as gives foreign designers.

This branch gives Ethiopia bonuses in certain states to strengthen them in the fight against ⟦0⟧. The focuses on the left gives Ethiopia offensive bonuses to their units while the focuses on the right gives penalties to ⟦1⟧ as well as fortifications on certain states.
The ⟦0⟧ branch will keep Haile Selassie I as the Emperor of Ethiopia.

Haile Selassie will remain in Ethiopia to fight the Italians more directly. This sub-branch sees Ethiopia go more independent of the international community. It will then centralize the nation under the Emperor. It allows the formation of the ⟦0⟧ as well as the ⟦1⟧ with expansion in the north and the ⟦2⟧ with expansion in the Caribbean.
While remaining the Ethiopian leader, Haile Selassie will leave the country to directly address the League of Nations to appeal for assistance. It also unlocks the ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧ continuous focuses.
An Audience with the Führer Sub-branch ( Germany)
An Audience with the Führer Sub-branch ( ⟦0⟧)

This hidden sub-branch is available when ⟦0⟧ accepts Ethiopia's appeal for a government in exile in their country. This gives bonuses for German technology and allows Germany to negotiate a peace deal with Italy or worsen relations between Germany and Italy.
The American Radio Address Sub-branch ( United Kingdom)
This hidden sub-branch is available when the ⟦0⟧ accepts Ethiopia's appeal for a government in exile in their country. This gives events that requests land from the British as well as manpower.
The American Radio Address Sub-branch ( Sweden)

This hidden sub-branch is available when ⟦0⟧ accepts Ethiopia's appeal for a government in exile in their country. This gives a free intelligence agency as well as fomenting a revolt in ⟦1⟧ and asking Sweden to join the war.
The Lion and the Sun Sub-branch ( Japan)
The Lion and the Sun Sub-branch ( ⟦0⟧)

This hidden sub-branch is available when ⟦0⟧ accepts Ethiopia's appeal for a government in exile in their country. This gives Ethiopia a navy from Japan, as well as Japanese help for the war at the cost of being a puppet under them.
Support Anti-Colonialist Resistance/Rebuilding the country Sub-branch

After the war, this shared section allows Ethiopia to rebuild, federalize the country so that the other Horn of Africa nations are able to use their focus trees. It also requests ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ to be annexed. In the end, it allows the creation of the African Union faction or the Organization of African Unity and foment the colonial nations to rebel against their overlords.
Reach Out to the Italians Branch

This ⟦0⟧ branch will trigger a civil war, but it allows Ethiopia to avoid total annexation and instead become an Italian collaborator. However, it all depends on whether or not the Italians accept or reject the proposal. This allows the country to turn into either in the north as ⟦1⟧ under Haile Selassie Gugsa as ⟦2⟧ under Hailu Telke Haymanot, or ⟦3⟧ in the south under Abba Jofir.
This keeps Ethiopia as a subject of ⟦0⟧ and allows the country to gain equipment, designers and territorial arrangements from ⟦1⟧.
This shared sub-branch gives different political advisors and mercenaries depending on the country chosen at the beginning of the branch.
This allows Ethiopia to rebel against ⟦0⟧ while taking Italian resources. This also starts a new war against ⟦1⟧ and allows the country to consolidate the region under the Empire.
A Callout to the World Sub-branch

This allows Ethiopia to appeal to communist nations abroad for aid. It gives the decision to form a decentralized ⟦0⟧ Ethiopia or a more centralized Ethiopia under The Workers Party of Ethiopia. It will then allow decisions to foment resistance in the Colonies in Africa.
This allows Ethiopia to aid ⟦0⟧ in the Spanish Civil War. It is only available if the ⟦1⟧ DLC is enabled.
Raise from the Ranks/Transformation of Nature/Laying the Tracks Sub-branch
This shared section gives political advisors and generals as well as build industry in Ethiopia.

This allows Ethiopia to request help from the ⟦0⟧ at the cost of becoming a ⟦1⟧. This will also give decisions to liberate African nations. The player may also decide to become free from ⟦2⟧ control at the risk of war.
This allows the creation of the Organization of African Unity and gives other African nations the choice to join. It will then allow Ethiopia to integrate faction members and create the ⟦0⟧.
When the ⟦0⟧ DLC is enabled, Ethiopia starts with the following ⟦1⟧:
⟦0⟧ begins with 2 research slots available; 3 more can be unlocked through the national focus tree.
